justification: Inspected [javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/utils/Log.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/utils/Log.java) and [javaparser-core-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/utils/LogTest.java](./javaparser-core-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/utils/LogTest.java). The target inner class is a small adapter with only three interface methods (`info`, `trace`, `error`) plus one private helper (`printStackTrace`), no fields, and a single responsibility of routing log output to stdout/stderr; the tests exercise only this adapter behavior. This is not enough structural evidence of insufficient modularization.
